title: [endoflife.ai] Product Approaching End of Life (30 days)
description: Alerts when a product you run (detected on your hosts by the stack scan or listed in EOL_PRODUCTS; tag detected:true) is within 30 days of its next scheduled end-of-life date - the proactive upgrade window. Warning fires at 60 days. When you list versions the date is that release line's. Catalog-only products never alert. Powered by endoflife.ai - https://endoflife.ai
